input_mode.title: Input Mode
input_mode.description: How to provide the annual report(s). Use 'pdf_urls' for direct PDF links, 'company_names' for auto-discovery via SEC EDGAR/web, or 'mixed' for both.

pdf_urls.title: PDF Report URLs
pdf_urls.description: Direct URLs to annual report or filing PDFs or HTML filings.

company_name_list.title: Company Name List
company_name_list.description: List of company names or ticker symbols. Works for US (SEC EDGAR) and international companies (annualreports.com, IR pages, SEDAR+, ASX, Companies House).

report_year.title: Report Year Filter
report_year.description: Target fiscal year. Leave empty for most recent.

preferred_sources.title: Preferred Acquisition Sources
preferred_sources.description: Which data sources to try when acquiring annual reports. Tried in order. 'sec' = SEC EDGAR (US), 'annualreports' = annualreports.com, 'ir_page' = company investor-relations website, 'international' = SEDAR+/ASX/Companies House, 'web_search' = DuckDuckGo/Bing search.

extraction_focus.title: Extraction Focus Areas
extraction_focus.description: Which intelligence categories to extract. Leave empty to extract all.

min_evidence_confidence.title: Minimum Evidence Confidence Score
min_evidence_confidence.description: Filter threshold (0.0–1.0). Lower = more results, less precise.

max_pages_per_doc.title: Max Pages to Process Per Document
max_pages_per_doc.description: Limit pages processed per PDF. Set to 0 for unlimited (slower).

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings for downloading documents.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: 'full' = all fields + evidence; 'compact' = top 5 of each; 'signals_only' = high-level signals only.

notify_webhook_url.title: Webhook Notification URL (Optional)
notify_webhook_url.description: POST results to this URL when processing completes.
